_comment: Scene encoder v2 (2026-10-09): LC11 (small moving objects) and LPLC2 (looming) populations per eye from the FlyWire v783 annotations; readout_dns = descending neurons that respond >15 Hz (top 12) to LC4/LPLC4/LC11/LPLC2 of either eye at 150 Hz in the np_sim sweep. all_dns = every descending neuron (super_class descending) in v783, for the null-model controls' readout selection. VS (VS1-8, VSm, VST) and HS (HSE/HSN/HSS) lobula plate tangential cells per eye: the fly's self-motion (optic flow) senses; driven with a baseline rate modulated by the character's velocity (VS -> DNp20/DNg46/DNp22 in the np_sim sweep). readout_dns also include the VS/HS (self-motion) top responders (>15 Hz at 200 Hz, top 12 per eye). v3 (2026-10-10): LC6/LC12/LC22 populations; readout_dns_v3 = readout_dns + their top responders (>15 Hz, top 12 per eye, same sweep).
